subject: PSO stall: translator const_loads fold prototype = fixed_frag SPIR-V 528 KB -> 3.4 KB, pair compile 0.44 s -> 0.08 s host (side copy only)
body: Prototype (scratch translator copy gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/m2v-fold, pin 720ef1ce, NO pin edit): canon/const_loads.rs folds every non-volatile non-atomic load of a field of a never-written constant global (same conditions as today's pointer-only fold; SCCP already folds whole-global loads of any type), patch gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/translator-const-loads-fold.patch (0000c77c). Host replay of corpus-c6jb (17 records, same replay binary, private libs via LD_LIBRARY_PATH): fixed_frag SPIR-V 528008->3372 and 527612->2840 bytes; the 2 fixed_frag pairs 0.41-0.47 s -> 0.078-0.083 s wall incl. process start; whole corpus 0.66 -> 0.40 s. Mali binaries of the other 15 records byte-identical. Fixed_frag: final NIR (pre-backend) equal modulo SSA names except (a) unused UBO x2/SSBO declarations gone, push block 72->68 bytes (translator metadata drives the frontend), (b) no SignedZeroInfNanPreserve execution mode any more (it was forced by instructions in the dead cases; live code is fast-math), which lets NIR turn bcsel(c,x+1,x) into x+b2f(c) - same value for x>=+0 (x=round_even of a clamped value). Expected device effect: fixed_frag variants ~1.2 s -> ~0.2 s each (air 560-900 + mali 230-650 ms today). Running: air bridge cargo test (34 contract tests) on the copy. Still needed before adoption: translator's own test suite + golden hashes (pin owner/root decision), corpus census refusal diff (metal-shader-corpus?), CA/render host gates with the new libs. Not a semantic shortcut: no refusal bypassed, interface exact per metadata.
